title: IAEA Live Chart: 1H is listed stable, abundance 99.9855
summary: The Live Chart ground-state row for 1H says STABLE and lists abundance 99.9855.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 1H (Z=1, N=0), extracted 2026-11-18, lists the half-life field as STABLE and the abundance field as 99.9855 with unc_a 0.0078. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 31-Oct-2005. Abundance here is the column in that row, not a new assay.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 1H
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides
sources.note: CSV row extracted 2026-11-18. ENSDF cut-off field: 31-Oct-2005.

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.
